run_interaction_prediction_training: run the interaction prediction module training loop with hydra config for robot manipulation tasks
predict_interaction_point: predict the closest voxel index and 3D position for robot interaction using the trained model
train_IPM_model: train the InteractionPredictionModule on robot datasets with cross-entropy loss and locality loss
validate_IPM_model: validate the InteractionPredictionModule on a dataset and compute prediction distance errors
encode_text_with_clip: encode natural language commands into embeddings using CLIP for language-conditioned interaction prediction
